name: Vane (formerly Perplexica)
description: Self-hosted, privacy-focused AI answering engine that searches the web and replies with cited sources.
whatItDoes: Acts as a private alternative to Perplexity: you ask a question and get a synthesised answer with source links. It is for individuals who want AI search on their own hardware with local or cloud models.
howItWorks: A Next.js application sends queries to a SearxNG metasearch instance, then has an LLM pick, read and summarise results into a cited answer. Model providers are configured in the UI and include Ollama for local models as well as hosted APIs. The standard Docker image bundles SearxNG; a slim image can point at an existing instance.

requirements.name: SEARXNG_API_URL
requirements.description: Existing SearxNG instance when using the slim image

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: A local Ollama server or a cloud provider key, set in the UI

models: Ollama local models, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq and others
